errors.evidence: The line representing the minimum demand is described as grey ("grau"), but it is clearly light blue in the figure.
The description omits that all three lines have circular markers at each data point, a visual feature the prompt asks to be included ("Markierungsform").

errors.text_span: ab 0,4 Eurocent/kWh bleibt die Nachfrage bei etwa 10.000 MW konstant
errors.evidence: This statement generalizes that all three lines remain constant at 10,000 MW from 0.4 Eurocent/kWh onwards. This is incorrect for the 'Minimum' line, which only reaches 10,000 MW at 0.5 Eurocent/kWh.

In the sentence describing the 'Mittelwert' (mean) line, it is stated that it rises to 10,000 MW at 0.5 Eurocent/kWh. However, the chart shows this line reaches 10,000 MW at 0.4 Eurocent/kWh and stays constant thereafter.
